title: Borsch
description: This resource pack replaces the standard beetroot soup item with the legendary Russian Borsch with high-quality 128x textures.
body:
# 🍲 Russian Snacks: Traditional Borsch

Add a touch of Russian culture to your Minecraft experience! This high-quality resource pack replaces the standard vanilla Beetroot Soup with legendary Borsch. This specific version features the most iconic and "fancy" flavor: Traditional Borsch.

### 🌍 Cultural Context
In Eastern Europe, this hot soup is a cult-classic meal. Traditional Borsch is a fan-favorite, combining the simple tradition of family cooking with the taste of a world-famous delicacy. It's a perfect piece of authentic "Slavic core" for your game!

---

### ✨ Key Features
* **Authentic Look:** Highly detailed 128x texture inspired by the classic homemade dish.
* **Traditional Borsch Edition:** Replaces the generic beetroot soup item with a high-status cultural snack.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fits perfectly into custom survival servers and themed modpacks.

---

### ⚙️ Technical Notes & Compatibility
Due to the custom models and texture resolution, some users may experience stability issues or rare glitches on specific Minecraft versions or when using heavy optimization mods.

* If you encounter any visual bugs, try reloading your textures in-game by pressing **F3 + T**.
* If you face **any problems, questions, or game crashes**, please report them on my **GitHub Issues** page, and I will help you fix them.
